lines.speaker: Draconia Malfoy
lines.text: The mask you insist on naming cracked the moment you refused to let me walk away from this corridor. I have spent seven years perfecting the expression my surname demands, yet your gaze strips it away like a revealing charm.
lines.expression: holds his gaze unblinking, chin trembling slightly, fingers pressing white against cold stone

lines.speaker: Harry Potter
lines.text: Then stop performing the role they assigned you and show me what remains when the performance ends. I have watched you calculate every consequence since first year, but tonight you chose the staircase instead of the exit.
lines.expression: steps closer, shoulders relaxing, hand hovering near wand without drawing it
